description: This file contains Armenian localization strings for the Select2 library version 4.0.6-rc.1, defining user interface messages and validation prompts in Armenian.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the Armenian message for an error encountered when loading results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the Armenian message prompting the user to remove excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the Armenian message prompting the user to enter more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the Armenian message indicating that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the Armenian message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the Armenian message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the Armenian message indicating that a search is in progress.
